repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
    wait until(not ((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true))
    triggered = false
}
wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(100, 0)
delay(3 SEC)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(0, 0)
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate polls the sensor only at the start of the 1s cycle. F1 shows motion went true at t=100ms; F2 confirms the JoI emitted no action then. The IR requires blocking on the rising edge, not periodic sampling.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with a blocking `wait until` for the rising edge, followed by the body actions. This ensures the action fires exactly when the edge occurs, preserving the IR timing.
